# Ignite — Brand Video Transcript

**Source:** YouTube, https://youtu.be/qHeuTD195Pg
**Channel:** Kate Burda (Kate Burda & Co)
**Published:** 2023.05.27 · **Length:** 1:30 · **Views:** 101 · No description, comments off
**Captured:** 2026.08.29 (auto-generated captions, punctuation added for readability; wording verbatim)

---

There's a gap between our financial vision and what we're doing to get there, and the gap is widening.

Ninety percent of our companies without strategies will fail. Sixty percent of organizations don't link strategy to overall financial goals. In our data, only five percent of marketing initiatives were focused on your most valuable customers. Ninety percent of tactics weren't aligned to those overall strategies.

We're all busy. So busy, in fact, we don't even realize our activity and output aren't creating the impact needed for us to get to where we want to go.

Maybe there's been a reduction in resources and tools and you're having to do more with less. Perhaps the plan you have doesn't get you from here to there. Maybe this ever-changing marketplace makes it just too difficult to put the right strategy together.

James Clear, author of Atomic Habits, said: you do not rise to the level of your goals, but you fall to the level of your system.

Ignite, a SaaS program, helps you to build a revenue roadmap from data-driven decisions that ensures the impact you need.

Organizations that have used Ignite have seen an increase of 19 to 25 [percent] in revenue. They have found anywhere from 1.3 to 2 million of overlooked revenue.

Ignite drives the clarity to get results. Ignite flips the script and says: do less, make it mean more.

## Notes for reuse

- **Structure:** gap → stats stacking the problem → empathy ("we're all busy") → objection handling → borrowed authority (Clear) → product → proof → tagline. Tight, 90 seconds, no product tour.
- **"Do less, make it mean more"** lands as the closing line. Confirms the current tagline.
- **The $1.3M-$2M overlooked revenue figure matches the MakeReady one-pager**, so it recurs across materials and is the most consistently used proof point.
- **The "19 to 25% increase in revenue" claim does not appear anywhere else in the business files.** Source and sample size unknown. Flagged per the verifiable-information rule: substantiate or drop before it goes to institutional buyers who will diligence it.
- **Dated 2023.** Predates the live app, Iggy, the Ignition Score, and the agentic-SaaS positioning in the 2026 press release. The emotional architecture holds; the product description does not.
